audit_result.proof_trace: The `emergencyWithdraw` function accepts an unconstrained `token` and `amount` parameter with only `onlyLegion` access control, performing no check that `token != bidToken` and no minimum balance guard ensuring `balance − amount >= sum(investedCapital)`. Because no accounting state is updated, a Legion bouncer call with the bidToken drains the contract while all investor `investedCapital` values remain positive, directly breaking the solvency invariant at any point in the raise lifecycle.
audit_result.attack_scenario: A compromised or malicious Legion bouncer calls `emergencyWithdraw(attackerAddress, bidToken, contractBalance)` while investors have active positions; all bidToken is transferred out but `investedCapital` entries remain nonzero, causing all subsequent `refund()` and `withdrawInvestedCapitalIfCanceled()` calls to revert due to insufficient balance.

PROP-legion-backe-inv-018.text: Contract bidToken balance must be >= sum of all unclaimed investor positions at all times.
